features.title: Unified Network Inventory
features.summary: Normalized multi-vendor inventory with search, filters, freshness and logical device views.
features.why: Creates the trusted SEE layer used by every later configuration, alignment and recovery workflow.

features.title: Failure-Aware Snapshot Semantics
features.summary: Separates collection failure, management-reported state and last-known-good evidence.
features.why: Prevents unavailable collection from being misrepresented as device failure or fresh state.

features.title: ClusterXL Inventory Hierarchy
features.summary: Represents ClusterXL clusters, members, VIP/member addresses and member-specific route/interface evidence.
features.why: Keeps physical member evidence without losing the logical cluster view.

features.title: VSX Inventory Hierarchy
features.summary: Models VSX physical members and Virtual Systems as a hierarchy instead of independent firewalls.
features.why: Preserves the execution endpoint/context relationship required for correct collection and later alignment.

features.title: PAN Runtime Inventory
features.summary: Discovers managed Palo Alto firewalls and VSYS runtime context through Panorama.
features.why: Provides management-led target discovery and topology for PAN current-state collection.

features.title: PAN Effective Configuration Evidence
features.summary: Collects direct-firewall effective-running configuration while retaining Panorama/local/merged provenance evidence.
features.why: Answers what the firewall is actually configured as now without confusing management intent with effective state.

features.title: PAN Expected ↔ Actual Alignment
features.summary: Compiles Panorama expected configuration and classifies setting-level alignment, override, member/provenance and drift states.
features.why: Separates benign local/member semantics from unexplained effective drift and reduces false positives.

features.title: Content-Addressed Configuration History
features.summary: Stores one immutable object per unique configuration payload while history snapshots reference shared content.
features.why: Preserves history without duplicating identical multi-gigabyte configuration payloads.
features.evidence: 1295 legacy snapshots migrated to 153 unique CAS objects; approximately 2.98 GiB duplicate payload storage reclaimed in the validated migration.

features.title: Configuration UI
features.summary: Vendor-neutral current configuration, evidence, alignment, history and backup placeholders with fleet/device drilldown.
features.why: Gives operators one consistent view while retaining vendor-specific evidence semantics underneath.

features.title: Development Workflow Modes
features.summary: Adds render-only, PAN-config, VSX-only, CP-only and full-checkpoint workflows with mixed-cycle provenance.
features.why: Keeps development loops fast without presenting partial reused evidence as a fresh full checkpoint.

features.title: Living Project Plan UI
features.summary: In-product roadmap, progress, Now/Next/Upcoming, backlog, completed-feature explanations and build history backed by versioned metadata files.
features.why: Keeps implementation position, deferred work and technical debt visible so build-by-build decisions do not get lost across long development cycles.

features.title: Check Point Configuration Evidence Probe
features.summary: Validated direct read-only Check Point actual-configuration evidence, identity gating and VSX context-specific collection.
features.why: Proved the collection semantics on real Standalone, ClusterXL and VSX devices before production promotion.

features.title: Check Point Current Configuration
features.summary: Collects secret-aware current Gaia configuration for Standalone, ClusterXL members, VSX hosts and Virtual Systems.
features.why: Extends Configuration beyond PAN while keeping member/VS context and raw-secret boundaries explicit.

features.title: CP Coverage Closure
features.summary: Closes shell/platform/metadata coverage gaps and distinguishes operational failure from unsupported capability.
features.why: A management-discovered device should be collectable according to observed capabilities, not a hard-coded shell assumption.

features.title: Discovery Lifecycle + Capability Profiles
features.summary: Management-led discovery lifecycle, topology/identity confidence and capability-driven collection plans.
features.why: Preserves zero-touch onboarding while making uncertainty explicit instead of automating by assumption.

features.title: Check Point Management Intent Alignment
features.summary: Compare Management intent/expected state with gateway/member/VS actual state using CP-specific semantics.
features.why: Adds VERIFY semantics without treating benign ClusterXL/VSX member differences as drift.

features.title: Unified Configuration History + Diff UX
features.summary: Chronological snapshot selection, normalized change views and safe configuration diffs. Device-scoped artifact timeline from CAS metadata; latest CHANGED pair diff for PAN; CP timeline + INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for diff.
features.why: Turns existing FIRST/SAME/CHANGED history signals into operator-usable TRACE workflows.

features.title: Vendor-Native Backup Foundation
features.summary: Vendor-native recovery artifacts, integrity validation, immutable history, retention and restore-readiness evidence.
features.why: Configuration evidence is useful for analysis but is not equivalent to a supported recovery backup.

features.title: Read-Plane Production Trust Hardening
features.summary: Close transport trust, credential, dependency and deployment hardening before production rollout.
features.why: Read-only does not remove the need for authenticated endpoints, trusted TLS/SSH and controlled secret handling.

features.title: Compliance Posture Foundation
features.summary: Builds an evidence-backed compliance control-area view from existing CP/PAN normalized configuration UI payload with fleet/subject drilldown and roadmap-linked planned controls.
features.why: Creates the VERIFY on-ramp without over-claiming certification: PASS/FINDING/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/PLANNED states remain bounded to observed evidence and explicit coverage limits.

criteria.label: Control state model with bounded evidence
No secret/raw config/real identity in compliance payload
Fleet summary plus anonymized per-subject drilldown

features.title: Compliance Control Pack v1 (CP/PAN)
features.summary: Expanded compliance posture with 10 vendor-neutral benchmark-aligned subject controls using CP/PAN normalized evidence adapters, with explicit control taxonomy and traceability metadata.
features.why: Strengthens VERIFY signal quality and transparency while preserving privacy boundaries and no-certification-claim semantics.

criteria.label: Compliance UI taxonomy clarity (top/sub menu semantics)
Privacy boundary and no-certification claim preserved

features.title: Compliance Rule Engine
features.early_foundation: Early evidence-backed control state model and framework area mappings delivered in 0.6.1B.1.5/1.6. Formal rule engine with versioned rule packs, stronger framework governance and compliance_posture_rulepack_transition bridge opens the 0.7.x track.
features.summary: Vendor-neutral rule evaluation over verified normalized configuration facts. Design + now/DEPLOY.1 split: docs/design/COMPLIANCE_ASSIGNMENT_AND_FRAMEWORKS.md (0.7.1 delivers the file-based, read-only foundation).
features.why: Transforms verified current/expected state into actionable compliance findings.

features.title: Framework Mappings
features.early_foundation: CIS/PCI-DSS/BDDK control-area mappings and benchmark references delivered in 0.6.1B.1.5/1.6 as evidence-bounded area mappings. Formal framework mapping with full rule coverage and governance acceptance is the 0.7.x gate.
features.summary: Map technical evidence/findings to internal and external control frameworks. Design + now/DEPLOY.1 split: docs/design/COMPLIANCE_ASSIGNMENT_AND_FRAMEWORKS.md (0.7.1 delivers the file-based, read-only foundation).
features.why: Connects engineering evidence to audit and governance requirements.

features.title: Evidence Reports
features.summary: Generate bounded evidence reports without exposing raw configuration secrets. Design + now/DEPLOY.1 split: docs/design/COMPLIANCE_ASSIGNMENT_AND_FRAMEWORKS.md (0.7.1 delivers the file-based, read-only foundation).
features.why: Supports review, audit and management communication from the same evidence model.

features.title: Cross-Vendor Change Timeline
features.summary: Trace normalized configuration changes across devices and vendors over time.
features.why: Makes change investigation independent of vendor-specific raw syntax.

features.title: Root Cause Trace
features.summary: Correlate evidence, alignment and history to explain what changed and why a finding appeared.
features.why: Moves from detecting difference to explaining causality and provenance.

features.title: Native Backup Validation
features.summary: Validate vendor-native recovery artifacts, hashes, archive integrity and retention.
features.why: Provides recovery evidence rather than assuming a collected config can restore a device.

features.title: Restore Readiness
features.summary: Track restore prerequisites, coverage and tested recovery readiness without automatically restoring devices.
features.why: Makes recovery posture measurable before any controlled restore operation exists.

features.title: Server Data Plane
features.summary: PostgreSQL metadata, Redis/workers and object/PVC storage for multi-user server deployment.
features.why: Moves local POC persistence into scalable services while retaining evidence contracts.

features.title: OIDC / RBAC / Audit
features.summary: Enterprise authentication, authorization and audited access to sensitive evidence/actions.
features.why: Required before broader multi-user production use and any future write plane.

features.title: Production Observability & Deployment
features.summary: Container/pod topology, health, metrics, logs, dependency and supply-chain controls.
features.why: Makes collector/network access boundaries and operational health supportable in production.

features.title: Collection Execution Coordinator & Safety Policy
features.summary: Per-device canonical identity lock, vendor/context concurrency budget, cooldown, coalescing, priority and job provenance across manual, scheduled and event-triggered collection.
features.why: Required before recurring scheduling or event-driven triggers; prevents concurrent CP/VSX/config collection hitting the same physical device simultaneously. Extends the 0.6.1B.1.3 safety audit finding into the scheduled-execution world.

criteria.label: Job provenance: manual / scheduled (event reserved only)
Shared production runtime admission and scheduler dispatch

features.title: DEPLOY.1A â€” Authenticated Read-Only Viewer Boundary
features.summary: Corporate OIDC login gate in front of all UI and API surfaces before the server is opened for internal use. IP allowlist remains as a defense-in-depth layer, not the primary control.
features.why: Network topology, rule sets and configuration evidence are sensitive even after redaction. Any internal server deployment must verify who is viewing before exposing the evidence plane.

criteria.label: No credential or raw operational artifact in browser/export

features.title: DEPLOY.1 â€” Evidence Egress & Sharing Policy
features.summary: Explicit policy and enforcement for every path evidence can leave the system: UI export, support bundle, audit log, webhook ingress persistence, TI enrichment query and OIDC claim retention.
features.why: As server, event intake and TI integration add new egress paths, a single governed policy prevents accidental exposure of topology, identities or raw configuration.

criteria.label: Retention and redaction rules per path

features.title: Cryptographic Posture, Crypto-Agility & PQC Readiness
features.summary: Normalize IPsec/IKE proposal, TLS policy, certificate and platform-capability facts for Check Point and Palo Alto; evaluate against versioned rule packs for crypto-agility, known-weak algorithms and PQC readiness. Distinct from and dependent on the core Compliance Rule Engine.
features.why: Turns existing configuration evidence into actionable crypto risk findings without adding new vendors or collectors. Supports NIST/PCI-DSS framework mappings and strategic PQC transition planning.

criteria.label: Configured vs negotiated vs inferred confidence model

features.title: External Change Signal Intake & Bounded Evidence Trigger
features.summary: Authenticated webhook ingress (e.g. Splunk correlation action) that validates, deduplicates and rate-limits inbound signals, resolves canonical device identity, and queues a bounded read-only evidence capture through the collection coordinator. Requires safe-diff and collection coordinator foundations.
features.why: Enables near-real-time configuration snapshots after policy-install events without polling, while preserving all existing safety and identity contracts.

criteria.label: Authenticated / signed webhook ingress (mTLS or OIDC-client)
Schema allowlist, replay protection and dedup/cooldown
Canonical device identity resolution via discovery lifecycle
Explicit signal outcome: triggered / coalesced / ignored / unknown_identity

features.title: Passive Threat-Intelligence Enrichment for Confirmed Changes
features.summary: After a normalized, confirmed diff finding is produced, extract safe observables and check against a local/corporate-proxy TI feed. Result is stored as contextual risk enrichment, not root-cause evidence. Internet API query is off by default.
features.why: Surfaces potential risk context without manual investigation, while keeping raw config, full topology and customer IP ranges inside the evidence boundary.

criteria.label: Safe observable extraction from normalized findings
Local/corporate-proxy TI feed integration (internet off by default)
TI match confidence, source, age and false-positive model

features.title: Corporate Git Repository Privacy Gate
features.summary: Offline fail-closed repository scan plus runtime-only inventory exclusion policy removes environment identities from the Corporate Git candidate without changing exact pre-poll filtering semantics.
features.why: Keeps operational identities and runtime artifacts outside Git/AI context while preserving deterministic device-selection behavior.

features.title: HA Readiness / Failover-Safety Assessment
features.summary: Read-only per-vendor preflight battery that scores whether an HA cluster is safe to fail over, and why not.
features.why: The safety net and foundation for any controlled failover; valuable on its own as a VERIFY-plane capability.

criteria.label: Per-vendor preflight battery (CP HA/LS/VSX, PAN A/P + A/A)
SAFE / DEGRADED / UNSAFE / INSUFFICIENT verdict with blocking line items

features.title: Failover Plan Compiler & Dry-Run
features.summary: Compiles the exact graceful vendor action, rollback, impact window and preemption note into a FailoverPlan. Dry-run only.
features.why: Makes the action explicit and reviewable before any write capability exists.

criteria.label: Compile active-initiated action + rollback per vendor/mode

features.title: Controlled Failover Execution
features.summary: The single write-capable component: one authorised action with snapshot / poll / verify / auto-rollback, full audit, and per-vendor adapters. Hard-gated.
features.why: The payoff of a trustworthy SEE/VERIFY/TRACE/RECOVER stack; the tool's first OPERATE capability.

criteria.label: One authorised action per run; re-assess between actions
Feature flag + per-run token + OIDC/RBAC OPERATE role + maintenance window
CP ClusterXL, CP VSX per-VS, PAN A/P (+A/A) action adapters
